Entries are generation seconds above runtime microseconds per point; \PAC\ runtime shows coloured wall and black pure-evaluator ratios, or absolute time without an \AC\ reference. \paragraph{Settings.}
\noindent\scriptsize \path{docs/result_matrix.py} (\texttt{--color-accuracy full}) writes this table and its JSON cache. \AC\ uses the raw generated-library path \texttt{amplicol\_generate --library=create-raw} followed by \texttt{amplicol\_color\_library\_probe}, preserving NLC/full colour-order interferences. \PAC\ uses Rusticol double precision, batch size 64, output chunk size 128,  Stage-local inputs, ten Horner iterations, default CPE rounds, expanded optimization limits, SymJIT O1, and \texttt{--target-runtime 10} are used. Only C++ O3 generation is subject to the 15-minute compile cap.
